programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Pregnant and recently widowed Cahya gets a job as a maid working in an isolated old mansion. Unable to take the loneliness anymore, she opens a doorway to the spirit world to reconnect with her late husband. In doing so, she inadvertently awakens the tormented ghosts of the mansion's previous owner and the maids.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers: Reborn
programme.desc: The Horror Hound festival holds its first ever event in Louisiana, attracting hundreds of geeks, freaks and die-hard horror fans from far and wide. Fanboy Chase forces his girlfriend Laine to come along for the ride. As the event begins, Laine starts to experience unexplained premonitions and disturbing visions. As the blood-soaked entertainment builds to a frenzy, Laine believes that something unearthly has been summoned and that she is at the center of it.

programme.title: The Slit Mouthed Woman
programme.desc: 30 years ago, in an ominous suburban town, the spirit of a woman turned up to terrorize youngsters. During her tragic lifetime, the woman in question had been severely disfigured by her psychotic husband, who slashed her from mouth-to-cheek with a pair of scissors. After her untimely death, she prowled the streets of the town, clad in a surgical mask and a long, sweeping coat, and would accost her victims, removing her mask to reveal her deformities as she queried, 'Am I pretty?' Any victim who answered negatively met an immediate grisly death. Now, after a lengthy absence, the woman's ghost returns to wreak another onslaught of terror on the community.

programme.title: The Slit Mouthed Woman 2
programme.desc: 1978, Gifu prefecture, Japan. Three sisters grow up on a chicken farm in a small town. The oldest sister, Yukie, is engaged to be married, the middle sister, Sachiko works at a beauty salon and the youngest, Mayu, is on the track team in high school. Their happy carefree lives are changed forever when Yukie's ex-boyfriend Suzuki commits an atrocious crime with Mayu as the tragic victim. Half-crazed and bent on revenge against their family, Suzuki mistakes Mayu for Yukie and pours acid all over her face. Overwhelmed by physical and psychological trauma, Mayu sinks deeper into depression and isolation, unresponsive to her sisters' encouragement. Meanwhile, chilling news of a serial murderer, who preys on the alumni of Mayu's high school, send shockwaves through their small town.

programme.title: Malaysian Ghost Stories
programme.desc: Nusantara is a place full of mystical spirits and the supernatural. Each episode has a unique solution depending on the type of disturbance, the type of genie and the effect on the main character.

programme.title: Susuk
programme.desc: Imran is a good son to his mother. He takes care of his mother even though his mother has been behaving strangely ever since she fell sick. This had Imran thinking that his mother is possibly practicing a black magic called Susuk. Imran asks for advice from a religious man in the mosque to help him remove the Susuk.

programme.title: The Boy Behind The Door
programme.desc: After Bobby and his best friend Kevin are kidnapped and taken to a strange house in the middle of nowhere, Bobby manages to escape. But as he starts to make a break for it, he hears Kevin's screams for help and realizes he can't leave his friend behind.

programme.title: Blacklight
programme.desc: Travis Block, a shadowy government agent who specializes in removing operatives whose covers have been exposed, uncovers a deadly conspiracy within his own ranks that reaches the highest echelons of power.

programme.title: Volkswagen Kuning
programme.desc: Although various myths have made up the urban legend of a yellow Volkswagen in Karak Highway, majority of locals agree on one fact: never to overtake the car. They know that if they ever do, the reckless, driver-less car will always find its way to imprison the souls of the livings in the car forever, joining those who have 'driven' the yellow Volkswagen.

programme.title: Project Gemini
programme.desc: Through an international project known as Gemini, a planet terraforming unit is formed. But the unit loses connection with Earth and floats out of the solar system. Years after the unit is considered lost, a group of astrophysicists receive a mysterious signal from outer space. A small group is sent off into the great and unkown abyss to locate the source of the signal and save the Earth from destruction.

programme.title: Janet: Sumpah Terlarang
programme.desc: Sarawak, 1970s. Janet, a nurse, heads home after ending a late-night shift. But she never shows up at home. On the way, she is kidnapped by mysterious assailants and butrally murdered in a horrific ritual, all to appease angry spirits that have been preventing the completion of the Satok Bridge. Fast forward to present-day Kuala Lumpur, where Julia, a Sarawakian girl, is a beaming bride-to-be and happily planning her wedding to Farid. Julia is well-received by her soon-to-be in-laws, but she has no idea about the terrible secrets from their past. One day, Janet picks up a hairpin to keep her hair tidy. What follows soon after changes her life forever.

programme.title: Puaka Balai Gombak
programme.desc: A group of arrogant paranormal seekers continuously discredit the existence of spiritual entities in popular haunted sites in Malaysia. In the process of defending her, Karim learns uncomfortable secrets about his missing wife and child that may cause him to lose everything. A gory bloodfest that interweaves politics, greed, black magic, decapitation and dismemberment, and demon possesions, this horror film is loosely based on the real and gruesome murder of politician, Datuk Mazlan Idris, by Mona Fandey, a washed-up singer-turned-witch doctor who was convicted in 1993. Originally slated for release in 2007, its controversial subject matter forced the film into cold storage, until it was finally shown in 2018.

programme.title: Hansel And Gretel

There, Eun-soo is trapped with the girl and her siblings who never age. Soon he learns that all the adults who visited or stayed in the house have met mysterious yet terrible ends. More shockingly, their cruel deaths are drawn in detail and made into a fairy tale book by the children. Scared, Eun-soo tries to find the way out, but the house is secluded in the forest with no way out. And then, Eun-soo finally discovers a book which tells the brutal end of none other than himself!
